title: Ghost holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M55 46 Q60 62 52 72' fill='none' stroke='#d8e6ff' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='30' rx='13' ry='16' fill='#ff5d7a'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='30' rx='13' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='#ffa8ba' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='24' rx='3.2' ry='5' fill='#ffc7d2'/>
  <polygon points='55,46 59,46 57,50' fill='#c73a55'/>
  <!-- ghost body -->
  <path d='M28 92 L28 55 Q28 26 50 26 Q72 26 72 55 L72 92 L65 84 L58 92 L50 84 L42 92 L35 84 Z'
        fill='#eaf2ff'/>
  <path d='M28 92 L28 55 Q28 26 50 26 Q72 26 72 55 L72 92 L65 84 L58 92 L50 84 L42 92 L35 84 Z'
        fill='none' stroke='#b8cdf0' stroke-width='2.4'/>
  <!-- inner shading on right edge of body -->
  <path d='M66 52 Q68 70 66 88' fill='none' stroke='#c7d8f5' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='50' rx='4.5' ry='6' fill='#3b4a8c'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='50' rx='4.5' ry='6' fill='#3b4a8c'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='48' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='48' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='61' rx='4' ry='2.6' fill='#ffb3c4'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='61' rx='4' ry='2.6' fill='#ffb3c4'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 61 Q50 66 54 61' fill='none' stroke='#3b4a8c' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little arms -->
  <path d='M29 64 Q20 62 19 54' fill='none' stroke='#eaf2ff' stroke-width='4.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M29 64 Q20 62 19 54' fill='none' stroke='#b8cdf0' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M71 64 Q78 60 79 54' fill='none' stroke='#eaf2ff' stroke-width='4.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M71 64 Q78 60 79 54' fill='none' stroke='#b8cdf0' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
